queries_run: Marvell MRVL analyst price target consensus October 2026
Marvell Technology guidance fiscal Q3 2027 revenue outlook analysts estimates

findings.claim: Benzinga 價目頁（約 2026-08-28 擷取）：26 位分析師、共識 Buy（23 Buy／3 Hold），平均目標價 $261；近期動作含 Craig-Hallum 調升至 $300、B. Riley 下調至 $315。
findings.excerpt: lists 26 analysts with a consensus "Buy" rating and an average target of $261, about 20.6% above the price at the time.

findings.claim: 各聚合站目標價分布（2026-07）：MarketBeat 平均 $245.45、37 位分析師、區間 $105–$400（07-21）；Investing.com UK 平均 $252.94、40 位（07-14）；Public.com $243.71、28 位。
findings.excerpt: MarketBeat reported an average 12-month target of $245.45, based on 37 analyst estimates ranging from $105 to $400 as of July 21, 2026.

findings.claim: FQ2'27 財報（2026-08-27）公司 FQ3 指引：營收約 $3.15B ±5%、non-GAAP EPS $1.10 ±$0.05，高於當時 Street 預期（營收 $3.03B、EPS $1.07）；non-GAAP 毛利率指引 57.5%–58.5%，低於 Q2 的 58.9%。
findings.source: Marvell 8-K Q2 FY27 press release exhibit 99.1; search summary of Benzinga/StockTwits
findings.excerpt: Net revenue is expected to be $3.150 billion +/- 5%. Non-GAAP diluted net income per share is expected to be $1.10 +/- $0.05 per share.

findings.claim: 財報後盤後股價約下跌 2%，市場關注 Q2 小幅優於預期與 Q3 毛利率指引走低，儘管多年展望上調。
findings.source: StockTwits: MRVL Stock Slips After-Hours Despite Raised Multi-Year Outlook
findings.excerpt: MRVL Stock Slips After-Hours Despite Raised Multi-Year Outlook — Investors Weigh Thin Q2 Beat, Lower Q3 Margin Outlook

note: 未找到 2026-10 的最新共識；最新為 8 月底。Benzinga 兩頁 Q3 共識數字不一致（EPS $1.04/營收 $3.15B vs EPS $1.03/營收 $3.03B）。FY27/FY28 上調數字（約 $12B/$18B）僅見二手來源，未對 8-K 查證，故未列為 finding。excerpt 取自搜尋工具回傳之摘要文字，非網頁原文。未做 sell-side 估值修正專題搜尋。
